verdict.rationale: The evidence shows in-product AI: the pricing page lists a 'Gemini AI assistant in Gmail', and Google Meet has an AI 'Take notes for me' feature. Both are only one-line mentions, with no detail on generating insights or suggestions from the user's own data. Missing for 10: documentation of AI-generated insights or suggestions over user data, coverage beyond Gmail and Meet (Docs, Sheets, Drive), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
